about.title: About Me
about.content: I'm a Computer Science undergraduate with a strong interest in the technology and computing industry. I enjoy learning how systems work, solving problems, and continuously building my skills through academic projects and hands-on practice. My interests include software development, quality assurance, cloud technologies, and emerging tech trends. I'm motivated by curiosity, growth, and the desire to turn ideas into practical solutions. Currently, I'm focused on strengthening my technical foundation while exploring opportunities to apply my knowledge in real-world environments. I'm always open to learning, collaboration, and new challenges that help me grow as a future tech professional.
